issues.legal_issue: A pending appeal concerning an earlier surplus-land determination becomes infructuous when the governing amended scheme requires the determination to begin afresh through a new notice and a prescribed sequence of determinations.
material_facts: The landholder did not submit a correct statement of his holdings, and the prescribed authority declared part of his land surplus after considering his objections.

The District Judge affirmed the surplus determination, and the landholder and his sons challenged the orders in constitutional proceedings; the appeal from the dismissal of those proceedings was pending when the amendment came into force.

The amendment required the prescribed authority to commence the ceiling-area determination afresh after issuing a new notice, first applying the principal Act as it stood before amendment and then applying it as amended.
issues.conclusion: The earlier determination proceedings had become infructuous under the amended scheme, making the appeal futile; the Court dismissed the appeal as infructuous. It did not decide whether the statutory words concerning pending proceedings technically abated proceedings in the High Court or Supreme Court.
issues.legal_principle: Section 19(1) of the amending Act, read with its proviso and Section 9(2) of the principal Act as inserted by Section 4 of the amending Act, required a fresh determination after notice. The proviso prescribed a sequence: first determine the ceiling area under the principal Act as it stood before amendment, and then redetermine it under the amended Act. This was procedural and made the earlier determinations, and consequently the appeal, infructuous. Section 5 of the amending Act set out the revised ceiling framework. No earlier case was relied on by the Court; Ram Adhar Singh was cited by counsel but not relied on or resolved.

predicates.appeal_from_surplus_land_determination: The proceeding is an appeal challenging an earlier determination of surplus land.
predicates.prior_determination_pending_when_new_reg: The challenge to the earlier determination remained pending when the new regime began.
predicates.fresh_notice_and_determination_required: The new regime required the authority to issue a fresh notice and begin the determination again.
predicates.determination_must_follow_old_then_amend: The new regime required the authority first to apply the earlier rules and then to redetermine the matter under the amended rules.

issues.definition: When an appeal challenges an earlier surplus-land determination that remained pending as a new regime took effect, and that regime requires a fresh noticed determination in a prescribed sequence, the appeal is infructuous.
